skill.displayName: PowPow CLI — PowPow 技能共享执行层：登录/发帖/建数字人/删帖（写操作默认预览，--confirm 才执行）

version.changelog: 首个公开版本。由 powpow-simple 1.0.4 执行层抽出并加固：publish / create-digital-human / delete-post 默认 dry-run（exit 3），--confirm 才执行；login 拒绝命令行传密码；session.json 0600；platformUrl 白名单锁定。供 powpow-simple 等编排技能调用。

llm.summary: The skill mostly matches its stated PowPow CLI purpose, but one image-upload command can perform an immediate authenticated upload despite the broader dry-run promise.

dimensions.detail: Network access to the pinned PowPow platform and optional Unsplash API use are disclosed and proportionate; local drafts, previews, and manifests are written only when composing or publishing.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install hooks, package manager scripts, external dependencies, or background setup were found; the artifact consists of Node.js scripts and configuration.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The safety contract says all write operations require dry-run and --confirm, and publish/create/delete implement that gate, but scripts/upload-image.js is documented and implemented as an immediate authenticated POST without --confirm.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill stores a reusable PowPow JWT in ~/.powpow/session.json or POWPOW_STATE_DIR with 0600 file permissions and provides logout cleanup; this is disclosed and proportionate but still credential persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The package is a local CLI layer for PowPow login, composing drafts, publishing posts, creating digital humans, uploading images, and deleting posts; those capabilities are purpose-aligned but include public platform writes and account-authenticated actions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this before installing if you expect every network write to require --confirm. Do not run upload-image on private images unless you intend to upload them to PowPow, and use logout on shared machines to remove the stored session token.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Confirmed in artifact code: standalone upload-image performs an authenticated image upload without --confirm, which conflicts with the broad dry-run wording even though internal publish/create upload paths are confirmation-gated.
[AE1] expected: The referenced scripts were present in the artifact and inspected locally, so the partial-inspection concern was not supported after review.
[TM1] expected: delete-post uses DELETE /api/posts/[id] as expected for its stated cleanup function, previews the target without --confirm, and only sends DELETE after --confirm.
[LP3] unexpected: The skill lacks machine-readable allowed-tools frontmatter, but the runtime scope is described in SKILL.md and the inspected files did not show hidden tool hijacking or escalation.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The supplied SARIF contained no results; independent artifact inspection found no embedded remote-code execution, persistence hooks, or tool spoofing.
